import asyncio as aio
import time
from asgiref.sync import sync_to_async as wrap


def synchronous():
    time.sleep(1)


async def probe():
    # Intentionally stall the loop to verify that our watchdog raises an alert.
    time.sleep(0)


async def offloaded():
    await aio.to_thread(time.sleep, 1)
    await wrap(time.sleep)(1)


async def premature():
    await aio.to_thread(time.sleep(1))


async def unresolved(client, time):
    client.wait()
    await time.sleep(1)


async def deferred(items):
    return (time.sleep(item) for item in items)


async def callback():
    await aio.to_thread(lambda: time.sleep(1))
